caption: Figure 2: Magentic-One features an Orchestrator agent that implements two loops: an outer loop and an inner loop. The outer loop (lighter background with solid arrows) manages the task ledger (containing facts, guesses, and plan). The inner loop (darker background with dotted arrows) manages the progress ledger (containing current progress, task assignment to agents).

Figure3: Performance of different ablations of Magentic-One (GPT-4o) on the GAIA development set measuring the number of correct tasks. In the first ablation we replace the Orchestrator with a simple Orchestrator. In the following ablations we remove individual agents from Magentic-One denoted by "-agent". The ablations show that all agents are essential to achieve the best performance.
